title: Implement article header validation at POST ingress
description:
Implement header validation: (1) mandatory RFC 5536 headers present (From, Date, Message-ID, Newsgroups, Subject); (2) Newsgroups: value lists only valid group name format (RFC 3977 pattern); (3) Date: is within ±24h of server time; (4) Message-ID: format is valid (<local@domain>); (5) no header field exceeds 998 bytes (RFC 5322). Artifact: reader/src/post/validate_headers.rs.

Acceptance:
- Missing mandatory header → 441 naming the missing field
- Invalid group name in Newsgroups: → 441
- Date out of ±24h window → 441
- Invalid Message-ID format → 441
- Oversized header field → 441
- All validation paths are unit-tested
